description: Source code for QuicProxyClientSocket class implementing a network socket for QUIC proxy connections, including connection management, request handling, and response processing.

classes.name: QuicProxyClientSocket
classes.description: Implements a network socket for QUIC proxy connections, managing connection states, request/response handling, and integration with QUIC streams and sessions.

methods.name: QuicProxyClientSocket
methods.description: Constructor initializing the QUIC proxy client socket with stream, session, proxy info, user agent, endpoint, logging, auth controller, and delegate.

methods.name: ~QuicProxyClientSocket
methods.description: Destructor that disconnects the socket and ends logging event.

methods.name: GetConnectResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response info for the connection attempt.

methods.name: GetAuthController
methods.description: Returns the authentication controller used by the socket.

methods.name: RestartWithAuth
methods.description: Attempts to restart the connection with authentication; currently returns an error indicating reuse is not possible.

methods.name: SetStreamPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the stream; currently a no-op.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initiates connection process, handling state transitions and callbacks.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Closes the connection and resets internal state.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and has no data to read.

methods.name: NetLog
methods.description: Returns the network log source.

methods.name: WasEverUsed
methods.description: Indicates if the session was ever used.

methods.name: WasAlpnNegotiated
methods.description: Indicates if ALPN was negotiated; always returns false.

methods.name: GetNegotiatedProtocol
methods.description: Returns the negotiated protocol; always unknown.

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL info; always returns false.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies socket tag; enforces that only default tags are used.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, handling asynchronous completion.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback for read completion, processes data and invokes user callback.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream, handling asynchronous completion.

methods.name: OnWriteComplete
methods.description: Callback for write completion, invokes user callback.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets receive buffer size; not implemented.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets send buffer size; not implemented.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Gets the peer address if connected.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Gets the local address if connected.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of I/O operations, progressing state machine.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main state machine loop for connection process.

methods.name: DoGenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates authentication token.

methods.name: DoGenerateAuthTokenComplete
methods.description: Completes auth token generation step.

methods.name: DoSendRequest
methods.description: Sends CONNECT request to proxy.

methods.name: DoSendRequestComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of request sending, transitions to response reading.

methods.name: DoReadReply
methods.description: Reads response headers from the stream.

methods.name: DoReadReplyComplete
methods.description: Processes response headers and determines success or failure.

methods.name: ProcessResponseHeaders
methods.description: Converts headers to HttpResponseInfo and validates.
